name: Ormer-Gatherer Mauger

intro.text: Ormers, it's a shell with a pearly inside. You can only gather them at the lowest spring tides, in season, and by hand. No diving. It's a good rule, and a lot of fun, and I'm not sharing my spots.

win: That's me cleaned out. Have an ormer. Don't tell the warden.
after: Ormers are a type of abalone and very slow to grow. They've been taken at certain tides since the old days. If the rules weren't strict, there'd be none left.
